Hell, I'm an introvert and have only made one new friend in the last 15 years. I have several friends, but they are friends I've had since high school and university. I honestly can't maintain any new friends and can barely maintain my current friends.

My suggestion to meet people is to search for local groups that do things you are interested in. Whether these groups meet online exclusively or in real life, it'll be good to associate with people that share a similar interest. And if you put yourself in these situations, don't be afraid to just say to someone you think you are clicking with that "hey, we should hang out sometime". Just focus on stuff you like to do and find groups that connect to that.

If nothing else, just give yourself time and soon you'll get to the age where other people are just nuisances to be avoided. ;)
